registered_before: any variant of this family was evaluated on any season (git: this file is committed before results.json exists)
frozen_protocol: Registered under the frozen research protocol. Nothing here changes a served NFL weight, projection, probability, EV, ranking or grade. The variant may not feed the prediction engine or a live card until a research_model_results row for it shows passed = true on its holdout, and then only through a validation report that promotes ONE module against the frozen baseline.
family_correction: three variants; the single selected variant is compared once; the holdout is not looked at by this registration

studies.title: NFL v2 prior decay: the carried prior re-anchored to the starter’s current-season play
studies.objective: Test whether the NFL model should let a quarterback’s current-season EPA per dropback replace the quarterback level baked into the carried 2025 prior, faster as his dropback sample grows, without changing any served weight.
studies.hypothesis: At 5-6 games the served model still carries 53-73% of last season’s team ratings, and those ratings include last season’s quarterback play; its QB term only measures the starter against his own club’s running level, so a starter whose play has moved (Darnold 2025 -> 2026) is under-reflected. A term that measures the stale part of the prior (the starter’s shrunk current-season value minus the club QB level the prior assumes, carried at the passing rating’s prior weight) lowers win-probability Brier and earns closing-line value against the incumbent.

incumbent.called: v1 in this study (the served model; the user brief calls it v1)
incumbent.definition: football/nfl_params_v2.js cfg exactly (carry 0.8, geometric prior alpha 0.10 / 0.06, QB prior -0.16 shrink 6, qb_out_diff, standardised strength ridge lambda 240), refitted walk-forward under the identical protocol by football/research/nfl_v2/backtest.js
incumbent.weights: the served weights are not changed by this study; the comparison refits both models on the same seasons

mechanism.q_season: q_season(starter) = (sum over his credited starts this season of dev x dropbacks + k_db x q_before) / (sum of dropbacks + k_db); dev = EPA per dropback minus the league mean before the game (training’s rule); q_before = his qbEff before his first start this season (his value now, if he has none)
mechanism.stale_part: qb_prior_gap(side) = w_pass(n) x (q_season(starter) - teamQbStart(club)); w_pass(n) = 0.9^n, the prior weight of the passing rating after n games; teamQbStart = the club QB level at the season break (0.8 x its end-of-season level), the level the carried prior assumes
mechanism.feature: qb_prior_gap = home - away, added to the strength model; its weight fitted by the same walk-forward standardised ridge (lambda 240) as every other term; an unnamed starter adds 0
mechanism.unchanged: every v1 feature, the team-rating decay (P0 45 geometric and P1 288 hyperbolic settings were already tested and rejected in round 1, football/research/nfl_v2/RESULTS.md), the context and total models, the margin PMF

decay_schedule.what: weight left on pre-season quarterback information inside the prior part of the passing rating, if the fitted weight carries the prior’s QB loading one for one: v1 = w_pass(n); PD-K = w_pass(n) x k_db / (k_db + dropbacks)
decay_schedule.assumption: 35 dropbacks per start (2026 Weeks 1-7: Darnold 33, Mahomes 33)

variants.role: central: about 5.7 starts of dropbacks to reach half weight

studies.training_window: walk-forward: each predicted season S is fitted on 2002..S-1 (rating warm-up from 1999)
studies.validation_window: 2010-2024 regular and postseason games with a closing spread and a final
studies.holdout_window: 2025 season: NOT evaluated by this registration; one look only, in a later preregistered run, and only if a variant is a finalist
studies.minimum_sample: 4,000 validation games for Brier; 400 early-line bets for CLV
studies.primary_metric: win-probability Brier score on 2010-2024 walk-forward predictions
secondary_metrics: CLV in spread points at the early-week line, 2020-2024 (the seasons nflverse’s git history timestamps): bets where |model margin - early line| >= 2, points the line moved from the early checkpoint to the close toward the model’s side (model_loop/clv_early/lines.py definitions: tau = latest kickoff of week W-1 + 5 h; a commit within 6 h before tau; Week 1 excluded; moves over 10 points dropped)
studies.decision_rule: Selection: of the three variants, the lowest 2010-2024 Brier (ties: log loss). FINALIST only if, against the incumbent on the same rows, it has (1) lower 2010-2024 Brier, (2) log loss no worse, (3) margin MAE no worse than +0.01, (4) lower Brier in at least 9 of the 15 validation seasons, and (5) 2020-2024 early-line CLV at least the incumbent’s (mean points per bet; both models’ bets at the same threshold). passed = true only if a finalist then beats the incumbent on the 2025 holdout on Brier AND log loss AND margin MAE with CLV no worse, in ONE look by a separate preregistered run. Until passed = true and a human promotes it, status stays experimental and it never prices a live card.

stage_a_validation: margin MAE not worse than v1 + 0.01
stage_b_holdout: one look at 2025 only after stage A
Brier AND log loss AND margin MAE better than v1
stage_c_live: shadow on 2026+ cards for at least 64 graded games
graded CLV against EdgeDesk’s own captured quotes >= v1 over the same games
promotion_criteria.on_any_failure: REJECTED: the version stays experimental (retired from consideration), the record keeps it

alternatives_considered: a pure by-week team decay (P0 geometric, P1 hyperbolic): already tested on 2010-2024 in round 1 and rejected; not re-run
separate faster decay for the pass-dependent ratings only: rejected in favour of a fitted term, which lets the ridge decide the size instead of a hand-set rate
replacing the QB term with raw 2026 EPA: the 2026-only replay is worse on 2026 Brier (docs/nfl-prior-decay/DIAGNOSIS.md §3.1)
forking_paths.choice_and_reason: one fitted term, three shrinkage constants spanning 2x either side of the central value; the central value (200 dropbacks) is the sample at which a 2026 starter’s EPA has roughly the reliability of half a season, chosen before any evaluation
forking_paths.data_already_seen: 2026 Weeks 1-7 (the diagnosis that motivated the hypothesis; the live season, never used to select); the 2010-2025 results of round 1-3 variants of OTHER families (results/variants.jsonl); no variant of this family has been evaluated on any season
forking_paths.stopping_rule: the three variants are each run once; no further variant of this family is evaluated without a new registration that counts them
